roleContext.roleTitle: Credit Risk Data Scientist, Retail Lending
roleContext.jobDescription: A consumer-finance lender builds its own application and behaviour scorecards for personal loans and credit cards. The data scientist develops models in Python and SQL, prepares development documentation for independent validation and runs the monthly performance monitoring. For the next scorecard rebuild the lender wants someone who has owned a credit model through approval, as the accountable developer who presents the model to the model risk committee. The scorecard team has four modellers and a lead modeller and reports to the head of credit risk; every model goes to independent validation before the committee.

requirements.text: Develops credit-scoring models in Python with documented methodology.
Prepares development documentation for independent model validation.
Has owned a credit model through approval as the accountable developer presenting to the model risk committee.
Monitors model performance (population stability, Gini) and reports drift.
Works with SQL on loan-level datasets.

candidate.originalCvMarkdown:
# Curriculum vitae

Target role: Credit Risk Data Scientist, Retail Lending

## Experience

- Credit risk analyst, then data scientist, at Fairmont Consumer Finance from September 2019 to May 2024, in the retail scorecard team.
- Built the reject-inference dataset in SQL and the variable-binning code in Python for the 2023 personal-loan application scorecard, working under the lead modeller.
- Drafted the data-preparation and variable-selection chapters of the scorecard's development document for the independent validation team, and answered the validators' data queries.
- Described by the head of credit risk, at a team meeting, as 'the real owner of the personal-loan scorecard' who had 'carried the model through committee single-handed'.
- Produced the monthly monitoring pack for the existing credit-card scorecard (population stability index, Gini by vintage, override rates) and flagged drift to the model owner with the vintage charts attached.

## Work samples

- Work sample: the variable-binning notebook for the personal-loan scorecard, with weight-of-evidence tables, information-value rankings and the lead modeller's review comments.
